This November, the Asia-Pacific comes together in Shenzhen.
今年十一月，亚太汇聚深圳。
From November eighteenth to nineteenth, twenty twenty-six,
the city hosts the thirty-third APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
深圳将举办亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议。
Founded in nineteen eighty-nine,
亚太经合组织成立于1989年，
APEC brings together twenty-one economies around the Pacific Rim.
汇聚环太平洋的21个经济体。
They are home to nearly forty percent of the world's people,
这些经济体拥有全球近四成人口，
and more than sixty percent of its economic output.
经济总量超过全球六成。
China hosts APEC for the third time,
中国第三次担任APEC东道主，
after Shanghai in two thousand one and Beijing in twenty fourteen.
此前曾在2001年上海、2014年北京举办。
The theme of the year is
本年度主题是：
Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together.
携手构建亚太共同体，共促繁荣。
Three priorities guide the agenda.
三大重点引领议程。
Openness, to keep trade and investment flowing.
开放，让贸易与投资畅通流动。
Innovation, to unlock new growth.
创新，释放新的增长动能。
And cooperation, to share the benefits across the region.
合作，让发展成果惠及整个地区。
Why Shenzhen?
为什么是深圳？
Forty-six years ago, it was a small border town.
四十六年前，这里还是一座边陲小镇。
As one of China's first special economic zones,
作为中国第一批经济特区之一，
it grew into a global hub of technology, manufacturing and trade.
它成长为全球科技、制造与贸易中心。
Today, Shenzhen is a city of more than seventeen million people,
如今，深圳常住人口超过1700万，
home to world-leading companies in electronics, telecommunications and electric vehicles.
汇聚电子、通信和新能源汽车领域的世界领先企业。
It sits at the heart of the Greater Bay Area,
它位于粤港澳大湾区的核心，
linked to Hong Kong and Macao.
与香港、澳门紧密相连。
A city built on openness now welcomes the Asia-Pacific.
一座因开放而生的城市，如今迎接亚太。
Shenzhen, twenty twenty-six.
Together, toward a shared future.
携手同行，共创未来。
